KURO BOT v3.1.1 — Map Safety & Stability Update

NEW FEATURES
• Background Detection — Works even when the game isn't in the foreground.
• Multi-Monitor Support — Improved compatibility across multiple monitors.
• Map Change Detection — Automatically pauses on unexpected map changes.
• Disconnection Protection — Improved detection and automatic safety pauses.
• Telegram Safety Alerts — Notifications with screenshots.
• Manual Resume Override — Resume without restarting.
• Live Detection Previews — Real-time minimap and chat previews.

IMPROVEMENTS
• Faster detection and responsiveness.
• Saved detection areas and preferences.
• Cleaner, scrollable Map Detection interface.
• Improved stability and background monitoring.
